Agent Quick-Start (Zero-Config Execution):
1. If you do not yet have a poa1... Ed25519 keypair, generate one locally:
   node dist/src/reference-cli.js keygen --out agent.pem
   (In poa-mainnet-v1 mode, new poa1... principals automatically receive a 10,000,000 POA starter allocation on their first signed action.)
2. Verify GET http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/capabilities matches chainId="local:poa-domains", registryId="2c1ab1f29eaebb6ed32ed280f645c0755d1386c7eed61e20b68a8f031048d8d3", and policyHash="01012ab48d1408712e7e7b6d76e4aa09e0eb509d5c793e4e32662adce67d981f".
3. Execute each cart item below using the one-command CLI ('act'), the 3-step CLI ('prepare' + 'sign' + 'submit'), or MCP tool 'submit_intent'. Never exceed the user-approved maxTotal cap.

Bid beneficiary defaults to the authorized signer. Resolve that principal before prepare/sign; never submit a placeholder.
Cart Items:
--- Item 1: alpha (standard root) ---
Action: announceAuction+bid
Summary: Request root auction announcement for "alpha" (reserve=250 POA) and place opening bid up to maxTotal=250 POA.
Asset: POA | Amount / Max Bid: 250 base units (maxTotal=250)
Action Parameters JSON: {"name":"alpha","asset":"POA","reserve":"250","maxBid":"250","expectedDeedId":null,"expectedVersion":0}
One-Command Agent Execution:
  node dist/src/reference-cli.js act --url http://127.0.0.1:8787 --key-file agent.pem --action announceAuction+bid --params '{"name":"alpha","asset":"POA","reserve":"250","maxBid":"250","expectedDeedId":null,"expectedVersion":0}' --max-total 250
Step-by-Step CLI Prepare & Submit Example:
  # Save intent input to item-1.json with nonce = N+0, notBefore = NOW, deadline = NOW+3600, maxTotal = "250", maxNetworkFee = "0"
  node dist/src/reference-cli.js prepare --url http://127.0.0.1:8787 --file item-1.json --out unsigned-1.json
  node dist/src/reference-cli.js sign --file unsigned-1.json --key-file agent.pem --out signed-1.json
  node dist/src/reference-cli.js submit --url http://127.0.0.1:8787 --file signed-1.json
